Question: Every day at school, Jo climbs a flight of \(6\) stairs. Jo can take the stairs \(1,\) \(2,\) or \(3\) at a time. For example, Jo could climb \(3,\) then \(1,\) then \(2.\) In how many ways can Jo climb the stairs?
